summary: SHELL32's SHGetKnownFolderPath as UnityPlayer calls it (FOLDERID_LocalAppDataLow, flags 0, no token): S_OK and a new block holding <profile>\AppData\LocalLow, an existing directory, no trailing backslash; the profile is C:\Users\<user>; LocalAppData and RoamingAppData are AppData\Local and AppData\Roaming; KF_FLAG_DONT_VERIFY and KF_FLAG_CREATE give the same path; ole32's CoTaskMemFree frees it and leaves the last error, NULL included.

evidence.quote: The calling process is responsible for freeing this resource once it is no longer needed by calling CoTaskMemFree, whether SHGetKnownFolderPath succeeds or not. The returned path does not include a trailing backslash. ... Not all KNOWNFOLDERID values are present on all systems.

open_questions: The last error after success is not part of the contract (the derive drops `err` from the SHGetKnownFolderPath rows): Windows leaves 1008 (ERROR_NO_TOKEN) for the profile, Local, Roaming and LocalLow with KF_FLAG_DONT_VERIFY, 0 for LocalLow, 183 after KF_FLAG_CREATE, on all four executions; the rows show no rule, and w2m leaves the last error as it was.
w2m's profile is C:\Users\w2m on a drive made fresh each run: nothing the game writes there outlives the run.

sections.excluded: proc: GetProcAddress(shell32, "SHGetKnownFolderPath") is not the import's address on Windows, though SHELL32 exports the name itself, not as a forwarder (exports run 38094046782); the cause is not established. w2m answers the import's address, as Windows does for CommandLineToArgvW (contracts/windows.module.system); nothing on the frontier compares the two; unregistered: an unregistered GUID: 0x80070002, *ppszPath NULL, last error 0.
